lead_headline: Restaurant tracker breaks two-day silence with zero new leads but 188 active leads in pipeline—liquor licensing freeze enters day 28

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads Wednesday—detection drought extends to day three as post-holiday silence continues. Active pipeline unchanged: 188 total (106 openings, 82 closures).

liquor.blurb: Day 28 of complete regulatory paralysis—Colorado's liquor licensing apparatus now frozen for full four weeks with zero applications filed, zero status updates processed, zero administrative movement since April 30. The May blackout enters its final days with no indication of impending thaw as all 12,396 tracked licenses remain locked in bureaucratic deep freeze. State officials maintain absolute radio silence on restoration timeline while the invisible application backlog accumulates behind sealed administrative doors. Memorial Day week passes with no disruption to the disruption as the licensing system sustains its unprecedented month-long suspension.

reputation.blurb: One mention Wednesday—the third consecutive day of single-digit pickup volume as post-Memorial Day lethargy persists. Weekly total reaches 37 mentions across 10 sources, down 45% from prior week's 67 as the holiday hangover depresses citation velocity. Instagram leads with 13 mentions (35% of weekly volume), Facebook and Denver Post tied at 6 each, Reddit contributes 4, Hoodline adds 3. Google News RSS exclusively drives all discovery (100% of 37 mentions). The sharp week-over-week decline confirms Memorial Day weekend's dampening effect on media pickup patterns, though monthly tracking remains elevated at 215 total mentions as May approaches its close.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled)—Memorial Day flatline stretches to third consecutive day of zero movement. MTD holds at +23 (+0.9/day), 90-day net stands at +135. Seven-day window shows net +3 (6 new, 3 canceled) as the sustained post-surge drought enters week three. May's pattern now unmistakable: concentrated mid-month burst (May 12-15) drove the bulk of monthly gains, followed by 13-day near-blackout through holiday weekend and beyond. YTD pace of +1.2/day continues outpacing the anemic MTD crawl, underscoring how thoroughly momentum collapsed after the brief spike as daily flow settles into minimal-to-zero equilibrium.
